newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury says data show healthy economic growth.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury says data show healthy economic growth.

text.p: The British Treasury said gross domestic product numbers on Friday confirmed the British economy was experiencing healthy growth.
"These figures confirm the economy is enjoying healthy, sustainable growth," a Treasury official said.

The Office for National Statistics said GDP in the fourth quarter was up an unrevised 0.8 percent from the previous quarter while the year-on-year rate was nudged up to 2.7 percent from a previous estimate of 2.6 percent.
